name: Sika ViscoCrete-1250

SIKA® VISCOCRETE®-1250: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sika_viscocrete_-1250.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is a third generation superplasticiser used to produce soft plastic concrete as well as state of the art, self compacting concrete (SCC) depending on dose rate.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is suitable for the production of the following types of concrete
    - Hot weather concrete and concrete with extended transportation or placing time.
    - Concrete requiring high water reduction.
    - High strength concrete.
    - Self-compacting concrete (SCC) or Super workable concrete.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High Range Water Reducer - HWR
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 will meet and exceed all requirements of AS1478.1-2000 High Range Water Reducing Admixture.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1-2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250, the following concrete properties are obtained:
    - High workability, flow ability and finish ability
    - Extremely high water reduction can be achieved, resulting in high early strength concrete.
    - Improved shrinkage and creep behaviour
    - Excellent flow ability achieved, results in better placement and compaction of the concrete.
    - Suitable for the production of Self Compacting Concrete and Super workable concrete.
    - No added chlorides
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of modified co-polymers.
    - Appearance and colour: Brown liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.07 g/cm³
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight .

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 can be used in conjunction with all Sika Concrete Admixtures, with the exclusion of Sikament NN.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage for soft concrete production is 350 ml - 1500 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. For self-compacting concrete, typical dosage is 900 ml - 3000 ml per 100kg of total cementitious material.
4.4 Dispensing. Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 is added together with the batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high range water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimum wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition. The addition of the slump water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time after the admixture addition, to avoid surplus water in the concrete. Do not add to a dry mix.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations. When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined with trial mixes.
    - Special mix designs are required to achieve Self Compacting Concrete (SCC)
    - Not recommended for use with normal range water reducers.
    - Please check compatibility when using with other admixtures.
    - Do not use with naphthalene-based admixtures.
    - For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined with trial mixes.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sika_viscocrete_-1250.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika ViscoCrete 1250, version 31/10/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/Sika%20Viscocrete%201250%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete®-1250, version 01/10/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sds-sika-viscocrete-1250.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
